{{Short description|Extension of a cyclic group by a cyclic group}}
In [[group theory]], a '''metacyclic group''' is an [[group extension|extension]] of a [[cyclic group]] by a cyclic group. Equivalently, a metacyclic group is a group <math>G</math> having a cyclic [[normal subgroup]] <math>N</math>, such that the [[quotient group|quotient]] <math>G/N</math> is also cyclic.

Metacyclic groups are [[Metabelian group|metabelian]] and [[Supersolvable group|supersolvable]]. In particular, they are [[Solvable group|solvable]].

== Definition ==

A group <math>G</math> is metacyclic if it has a normal subgroup <math>N</math> such that <math>N</math> and <math>G/N</math> are both cyclic.<ref name="Kida">{{cite journal |last1=Kida |first1=Masanari |title=On metacyclic extensions |journal=Journal de Théorie des Nombres de Bordeaux |date=2012 |volume=24 |issue=2 |pages=339–353 |url=https://www.jstor.org/stable/43973107 |issn=1246-7405}}</ref>

In some older books, an inequivalent definition is used: a group <math>G</math> is metacyclic if the [[commutator subgroup]] <math>[G,G]</math> and <math>G/[G,G]</math> are both cyclic.<ref>{{cite book | last=Hall | first=Marshall Jr. | title=The Theory of Groups | year=1959 | author-link=Marshall Hall (mathematician) | location=New York | publisher=Macmillan |mr=103215}}</ref> This is a strictly stronger property than the one used in this article: for example, the [[quaternion group]] is not metacyclic by this definition.

==Examples==
* Any [[cyclic group]] is metacyclic.
* The [[direct product of groups|direct product]] or [[semidirect product]] of two cyclic groups is metacyclic.  These include the [[dihedral group]]s and the [[quasidihedral group]]s.
* The [[dicyclic group]]s are metacyclic. (Note that a dicyclic group is not necessarily a semidirect product of two cyclic groups.)
* Every [[finite group]] of [[Square-free integer|squarefree]] order is metacyclic.
* More generally every [[Z-group#Groups whose Sylow subgroups are cyclic|Z-group]] is metacyclic.  A Z-group is a finite group whose [[Sylow subgroup]]s are cyclic.
